title: 3 hurt in 7-vehicle smashup in Pagadian City

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—Three people were injured in a seven-vehicle collision triggered by a runaway delivery truck along Rizal Avenue in Barangay Sta. Lucia in this city Friday noon, Nov. 27. Police Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson for the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office, said the crash occurred at 12:10 p.m. near the corner of Duterte Street. Initial investigation by the Pagadian City Police Station showed that a white Isuzu Elf drop-side truck, loaded with about 200 boxes of assorted dried fish, was negotiating an uphill stretch when it lost engine power and suffered brake failure.
